meta.name: alterlab-esm
meta.description: Run ESM protein language models — ESM3 for generative multimodal protein design across sequence, structure, and function, and ESM C for efficient embeddings and representations — locally or via the cloud Forge API. Use when working with protein sequences, structures, or function prediction, designing novel proteins, generating protein embeddings, performing inverse folding, or doing protein-engineering tasks. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用蛋白质语言模型设计新蛋白
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做蛋白质工程或功能预测
copy.tagline_en: Design novel proteins with protein language models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on protein engineering or function prediction

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以运行 ESM 蛋白质语言模型：用 ESM3 生成新蛋白质序列、预测结构、设计序列；用 ESM C 提取蛋白质嵌入向量用于分类或相似性分析。
howto.when: 当你需要处理蛋白质序列、结构或功能预测，设计新蛋白质，生成蛋白质嵌入，进行反向折叠或蛋白质工程任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ESM3 生成一段 100 个氨基酸的荧光蛋白序列。
say.note: Claude 会调用 ESM3 模型生成序列。

say.text: 用 ESM C 提取这段蛋白质序列的嵌入向量。
say.note: Claude 会调用 ESM C 模型计算嵌入。

say.text: 根据这个 PDB 结构，用 ESM3 设计一个能折叠成该结构的序列。
say.note: Claude 会执行反向折叠任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run ESM protein language models: use ESM3 to generate novel protein sequences, predict structures, and design sequences; use ESM C to extract protein embeddings for classification or similarity analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to work with protein sequences, structures, or function prediction, design novel proteins, generate protein embeddings, perform inverse folding, or do protein-engineering tasks.

say_en.text: Generate a 100-residue fluorescent protein sequence using ESM3.
say_en.note: Claude will call the ESM3 model to generate the sequence.

say_en.text: Extract embeddings for this protein sequence using ESM C.
say_en.note: Claude will call the ESM C model to compute embeddings.

say_en.text: Design a sequence that folds into this PDB structure using ESM3.
